assumptions.claim: The Keccak state width parameter StateW must be 1600 and must not be modified.
assumptions.cond: Any instantiation or use of sha3_pkg definitions that depend on StateW.
assumptions.risk: If StateW is changed, the SHA-3 padding logic that assumes 1600 will silently produce incorrect padding.

uncertain_points.cond: When the design is integrated or when StateW is set.
